test_title: SSC MTS 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 12 Sept, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Which figure should replace the question mark (?) if the following figure series were to be continued? 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b5b22bfefbd160ead28515346c4d14c42c0fcfe1a383549ee5012954d63233db.png]
solution:
The figure that will replace the question mark (?) in the following figure series is shown below:

1) For first box alternate series : 

 
• Alternately first row elements shifts in the clockwise direction.
 
• Alternately second and third row elements shifts in the clockwise direction. 

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/638ae5ba1321352f614d88e081cfecb2700e0b542767b6b6dcf1ed1a93788d64.png] 

2) For second box alternate series :

 
• Alternately first element from first row and second row elements shifts in the upward clockwise direction.
 
• Alternately second element from first column and first element from third column interchange positions.
 
• Alternately second element from second column is replaced by new element and remains constant i.e ' [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/70b38f49118a1af818c9fd52e2ef171820cbc8d2c81fdb3d928006fe1ce1c175.png] ' is replaced by ' [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9dedf9f27ddadcbe57f780c2394ddfb5bb5ad83606365647b71fa25751318fda.png] ' and ' [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2a155dc28d3ddd285f231a6f225c5f1055a63cc88ad905c6a2225e06b739f552.png] ' is replaced by ' [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/af8d6e551d78e239acf502810976829a9af0331ee61d6e45481feaac5c8acf94.png] '.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c9638d23ae9caf1d487659167de50cd32ea3b0d414f8c5777a569d371cae8599.png] 

The final series is :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c450bb0ab38387847fe687930b3b28ad375af783c62f9e90004e85d0197be1af.png] 

Hence, ‘option - (3)’ is the correct answer.
